recommendation: Keep this audit as-is for core. Do not reintroduce or edit the retired Observation genetics CIGAR extension in current FHIR source; any legacy guidance should remain in historical publication context or external genomics guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-8037 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the old Observation genetics CIGAR extension. It asked that the extension definition specify extended CIGAR format instead of mixing CIGAR terminology with alignment-string wording that described A/T/C/G case and dashes.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-8037. Historical source shows the requested wording was applied in commit a5c7c1d3520d1416f5c3356f71202601f3750063, which changed source/observation/observation-genetics-profile-spreadsheet.xml from the old confusing description to 'Extended CIGAR string for aligning the sequence with reference bases' and the Illumina extended-CIGAR reference. Later refactors carried the wording into derived .sheet.txt files and then MolecularSequence artifacts.
additional_context: The seed Jira's 2022 comment says the extension was removed in R5. Current source/fhir.ini still lists Observation as active, but current source has no geneticsCIGAR, Extended CIGAR, observedAllele/referenceAllele, or MolecularSequence.cigar definition to edit. Commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435 removed the outdated Observation clinical genomics profiles, extensions, examples, and related spreadsheets from core. The FHIR Extension Pack retains some retired/deprecated Observation genetics extensions pointing to the Genomics Reporting Guide, but it has no geneticsCIGAR definition. FHIR-8085 has already been audited on the combined branch as retired genetics CIGAR guidance, and FHIR-37414 later removed the MolecularSequence cigar attribute.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The original clarification was historically applied, and there is no current core or extension-pack geneticsCIGAR source where a further wording fix would affect the current build.

related_jiras.note: Another old Observation genetics CIGAR issue; already represented on the combined branch by commit 5c184530c569641c85e14253eefb69234bf5c981 as a no-change audit for retired genetics CIGAR guidance.
Published/Persuasive R5 issue and source commit 9005b714065f69130872740b475cb3133c835057 removed MolecularSequence.cigar, confirming CIGAR text was not retained as current core model content.
